description: This file is a shell script that sets up and runs tests involving Git operations, including patch application and diff verification. It includes embedded text files and shell commands to automate test cases for a version control scenario.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a descriptive label.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Sets the test environment time tick for reproducibility.

methods.name: git add
methods.description: Stages files into the Git index.

methods.name: git commit
methods.description: Commits staged changes to the repository.

methods.name: test_set_edit
methods.description: Sets a custom editor for Git commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Ensures a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that a command exits with a specific code.

methods.name: git reset
methods.description: Resets the repository to a previous state.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
